Enrichment. or a quasi-contract theory. Moreover, Carlos Warehouse predated the Supreme Court’s directive in Penn

from a claim for Breach of Contract. In light of the binding command of the Virgin Islands Supreme Court in Penn
that “the Appellate Division is cautioned to look at the factual substance of the testimony of pro se Small Claims
parties and consider legal theories that might be implicated Id. at 897 (citing Cape Air Int'l, 53 V.1. at 619), this

Debt.” The facts giving rise to such a situation would be informative as to the best formulation of the elements of
